analysis: The trial executed successfully but validation HR@10 fell to 0.5637, down 0.0413 from equal-weight reciprocal-rank fusion (0.605) and 0.0563 from the historical mean-rank reference (0.620). Category HR@10 was Movies_and_TV 0.615, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.575, Electronics 0.390, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.675. All four declined versus the supplied previous category results. This experiment does not support increasing MultVAE’s fusion weight to 0.75; it does not establish which member caused the regression. Allocated GPU time was 522.02 seconds.
code_summary: Retained independently trained MultVAE and SASRec models for all four datasets. MultVAE uses normalized binary histories, a 256-unit hidden layer, 64-dimensional latent representation, reconstruction loss, and annealed KL regularization. SASRec uses length-50 sequences, 50-dimensional embeddings, two attention blocks, and positive-plus-16-negative cross-entropy. Fusion combines stable one-based candidate ranks as 0.75/(10+r_vae) + 0.25/(10+r_sasrec). Training settings and checkpoint selection remain unchanged. The exported predictor loads both checkpoints and shares local scoring helpers; metadata and deterministic fusion fixtures reflect the new weights.
